scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Denison University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, published, updated 2026-08-14)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class, CDS C1: 12,202 applied, 2,385 admitted, 623 enrolled (all full-time); the in-state (Ohio), out-of-state and international rows add up to the applicant, admit and enrolled totals. International first-years: 5,641 applied, 430 admitted, 62 enrolled (C1). Early Decision figures (C21): 1,589 applications, 394 admitted; the CDS says Denison has no early action plan (C22 'No'). SAT/ACT are optional: 26.6% (166 students) of the entering class submitted the SAT and 18.6% (116) the ACT. The CDS leaves the GPA table (C11) and average GPA (C12) blank, so no GPA figures are shown. Undergraduate enrollment (2,458) and the international count (384) are the B1/B2 'total undergraduates' figures (international = nonresidents, degree- and non-degree-seeking).

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set G1/G5: tuition $74,000 (the CDS lists no separate required-fee line), on-campus food and housing $18,400; estimated books and supplies $1,000 and other expenses $3,500. The 2026-27 online catalog prints the same tuition ($74,000) and housing and food ($18,400). The college prints no 2026-27 total cost of attendance (the catalog's total sentence still says 2025-2026), so none is shown. CDS H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 358 degree-seeking nonresidents received it (average $55,613, total $19,909,430, aid year 2025-26 as marked on the CDS).
